slides.title: What is Feature Engineering and What is Featuretools
slides.text: What is Feature Engineering and What is Featuretools ? Feature Engineering is the process in which taking a dataset and constructing explanatory variables (features) that can be used for a machine learning model. Featuretools is a framework to perform automated feature engineering. It excels at transforming temporal and relational datasets into feature matrices for machine learning.

slides.title: What is Automatic Feature Engineering Important? Feature Engineering
slides.text: What is Automatic Feature Engineering Important? Feature Engineering is the most important aspect of the machine learning pipeline! Making it automated will help with: Saving time Building better predictive models Creating meaningful features Preventing data leakage

slides.title: History of Featuretools In 2015, researchers at MIT
slides.text: History of Featuretools In 2015, researchers at MIT presented the Deep Feature Synthesis algorithm and demonstrated its effectiveness in online data science competitions where it beat 615 of 906 human teams. This is an open source library in python called Featuretools . James Max Kanter and Kalyan Veeramachaneni both from MIT
